title: Returns & Exchanges Shoebox Fee
content:
Footwear must come back in its original, undamaged shoebox. This fee schedule sets the Returns & Exchanges shoebox fee withheld on a footwear line whose units came back without the original box, in a damaged box or in a box used as the shipping carton.

## Fee

1. **Per unit.** The shoebox fee per unit is the return type's missing box fee. The fee per unit is rounded half up to the cent once, as the last step in arriving at it.
2. **Ceiling.** The fee per unit is never larger than the pair's net unit price paid: its booked unit price less its checkout promotion discount, late promotion credit and price adjustment, each per unit booked.
3. **Fee withheld.** The fee per unit times the line's units inspected with that box condition, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical; a return type whose missing box fee is 10.00 USD)

| Line | Fee per unit | Units with that box condition | Fee withheld |
|---|---|---|---|
| Running shoes, net unit price paid 110.00 | 10.00 | 2 | 20.00 |
| Sandals, net unit price paid 8.00 | 8.00 (the net unit price paid is lower) | 1 | 8.00 |

The net unit price paid of the sandals in the second row is 12.00 booked, less a 4.00 checkout promotion discount on a line of 1 unit: 8.00.
